what: The first call waited 22 minutes and never held the lock: a daemon started by an earlier caller's command had inherited the lock's descriptor. Its output, piped to `tail`, showed nothing meanwhile, so a queue and a stuck lock looked the same.
cost: 22 minutes with no measurement; the baseline of this lane was never taken on its own tree before the change
cause: the lock's descriptor was open in the children of the loop
workaround: none from a lane; the coordinator ended the call
fix: done by the coordinator: children start with the lock closed, a watchdog ends a stray holder
state: fixed in /root/loop.sh on the VM (not in the tree)
